title: Impact of carbamazepine on SMARCA4 (BRG1) expression in colorectal cancer: modulation by KRAS mutation status.
authors: Shaykevich, Aaron; Chae, Danbee; Silverman, Isaac; Bassali, Jeremy; Louloueian, Netanel; Siegman, Alexander; Bandyopadhyaya, Gargi; Goel, Sanjay; Maitra, Radhashree
one_liner_zh: 该文研究卡马西平对结直肠癌中SMARCA4表达及KRAS突变状态的影响，虽含分子对接模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白作用与癌症治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: SMARCA4 is a gene traditionally considered a tumor suppressor. Recent research has however found that SMARCA4 likely promotes cancer growth and is a good target for cancer treatment. The drug carbamazepine, an autophagy inducer, was used on colorectal cancer cell lines, HCT1116 and Hke3 (KRAS mutant and wildtype). Our study finds that Carbamazepine affects SMARCA4 levels and that this effect is different depending on the KRAS mutation status. This study analyzes the effect of carbamazepine on early-stage autophagy via ULK1 as well as simulates the docking of carbamazepine on KRAS, depending on the mutation status. Our study highlights the therapeutic uses of carbamazepine on cancer, and we propose that carbamazepine in conjunction with other chemotherapies may prove useful in targeting KRAS-mutated colorectal cancer.
abstract_zh: SMARCA4是一个传统上被视为肿瘤抑制基因的基因。然而，近期研究发现SMARCA4可能促进癌症生长，并且是癌症治疗的良好靶点。药物卡马西平（carbamazepine），一种自噬诱导剂，被用于结直肠癌细胞系HCT1116和Hke3（KRAS突变型和野生型）的处理。我们的研究发现，卡马西平影响SMARCA4水平，且这种效应因KRAS突变状态的不同而有所差异。本研究分析了卡马西平通过ULK1对早期自噬的影响，并根据突变状态模拟了卡马西平在KRAS上的对接。我们的研究强调了卡马西平在癌症治疗中的潜在用途，并提出卡马西平与其他化疗药物联合使用可能有助于靶向KRAS突变的结直肠癌。
